subway.title: Seoul subway arrivals
subway.description: Enter a Seoul Open Data Plaza subway key and exact station name (without the station suffix). Setup also works when no trains are running. Polling defaults to 120 seconds; requests sharing a key are capped at 950 daily. The Seoul API uses HTTP: the key and station travel in plaintext. Consent is required. The key is stored unencrypted in HA settings and backups. Re-enter it when reconfiguring.
